complete_scope: Coverage expansion and recorded defect fixes complete, not a claim that the final source reran/passed all 16 fresh full model flows.
final_source_delta: After 16-case matrix: clarify soft vs hard and practical vs physical. Four targeted flows fixed parsing but one selected non-selling placeholders; grounding prompt added. Two subsequent full flows selected concrete products, but nonfood planner omitted explicit milk-tea exclusion. Final source merges conservative literal Chinese negative lists, with six synthetic checks and one fresh real planning call plus actual SQL query validation. No final fresh recommendation inference after the literal guard.
